decisions.reason: The source refines only the Hero V arm relationship and silhouette; it does not change the deferred E and L construction requirements.
The closing V must still derive from the Hero V geometry. The source changes that master geometry but does not alter or invalidate the candidate's existing derivation rule.
The É accent's requirement to derive from and correspond with the Hero V remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a separate accent modification.
The source concerns black-and-white Hero V geometry and does not change the deferred champagne material direction or its application constraint.
Although the source explains the desired design direction, it does not change the requirement to provide a short rationale with each design round.
The Hero V silhouette refinement does not change the deferred wordmark kerning or cohesive-reading requirements.
The source contains no decision about review-image delivery formats or file accessibility.
